name: The Demon Scarred Cloak
summary: In Mulgore, The Demon Scarred Cloak carries the wounds of Ghost Howl's torment. The hide came from a legendary white wolf scarred by the Burning Legion. Its arrival in Bloodhoof Village brings the beast's troubled story to a close.

sections.title: A Relic of Fel Wounds
sections.body: Ghost Howl is a legendary white wolf whose sorrowful howl carries across Mulgore. The hide left by the beast bears the scars of demonic corruption. Those marks came from desperate battles against the invading demons of the Burning Legion. The wounds lingered in Ghost Howl's flesh and spirit long after the Third War.

sections.title: Peace for a Troubled Spirit
sections.body: Mulgore's tauren revere the wild beasts of their homeland as children of the Earth Mother. In Bloodhoof Village, Skorn Whitecloud receives the scarred cloak as proof that the tormented predator is dead. He recognizes the skill it took to track and defeat Ghost Howl. Somberly, he hopes the wolf's tortured spirit has found peace.

faq.q: What is the Demon Scarred Cloak?
faq.answer: The Demon Scarred Cloak is the ragged hide left by Ghost Howl, a legendary white wolf in Mulgore. Fel energies scarred it in an old battle against the Burning Legion.

faq.q: Where did the demon scars on the cloak come from?
aliases: how did ghost howl get scarred
faq.answer: Ghost Howl was wounded in clashes with the Burning Legion's invading demons during the Third War, as they pushed across Kalimdor.

faq.q: Who do I bring the cloak to?
aliases: where do i turn in demon scarred cloak
faq.answer: Bring the cloak to Skorn Whitecloud, an elder tauren hunter who lives in Bloodhoof Village in Mulgore.

faq.q: Why does Skorn Whitecloud care about Ghost Howl?
aliases: why does skorn want ghost howl
faq.answer: Skorn Whitecloud is a retired hunter who knows Ghost Howl suffered deeply from demonic corruption. He respects the skill it took to fell the beast and hopes its spirit can finally rest.
Ghost Howl roams Mulgore's rolling plains, usually in the northern or central open fields between Red Cloud Mesa and Thunder Bluff.

faq.q: Why do the tauren hope the wolf's spirit finds peace?
faq.answer: Tauren revere wild spirits and seek harmony with nature. Demonic corruption tormented Ghost Howl, so the tauren see the wolf's defeat as a merciful release back to the Earth Mother.

angles.text: As a Shu'halo, you can see the hunt for Ghost Howl as a somber rite that frees an agonized creature from the Burning Legion's lingering taint.
As a hunter, you know tracking down a lone, scarred alpha like Ghost Howl is a rite of passage. Elder Skorn Whitecloud praises the skill and gives a master hunter's gift.
As a druid, you see the demon-scarred pelt as a grim reminder that the land and its wild inhabitants still bear unhealed wounds from the demonic invasion of Kalimdor.
